svg.aria-label: A table of sixteen claims with verdicts and grades. Zone 2 builds mitochondria better than harder training: Not supported, grade A; Riding at peak fat burning is best for losing fat: Not supported, grade B; Zone 2 is what trains lactate clearance: Not shown, grade C; Elite endurance athletes do most of their training easy: Supported, grade C; Copying the elite ratio makes amateurs faster than other mixes: Not shown, grade B; Years of easy volume build an engine intervals can't: Unknown, grade C; Two hard sessions a week, at least 48 hours apart: Supported, grade B; Intervals of 4 to 8 minutes, or 30/15s, for long efforts: Supported, grade B; Time near VO₂max is why intervals work: Not shown, grade C; Long rides build durability: Plausible, grade C; Carbohydrate on rides over two hours helps: Supported, grade A; Heavy leg lifting makes trained cyclists a little faster: Supported, small, grade B; Heat training makes amateurs faster in normal weather: Not shown, grade C; Zone 2 is the best training for health: Not shown, grade C; Zones from 220 minus age or a fixed % of maximum: Not supported, grade B; Add no more than 10% a week: Not supported, grade B

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The verdict on sixteen claims, with the grade of the evidence

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A: several randomised trials or a good meta-analysis. B: small, short or single-lab

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: studies. C: observation, mechanism or opinion.
